title: Wonderlands×Showtime Chapter1 Episode18 The Lonely Alchemist

rows.Line: Main Street

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui told you that you can't make great shows alone...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yeah. I lost my nerve then, and couldn't articulate myself.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see. Let's go to Rui's house.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh? You know where he lives?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. We've been neighbors since elementary school.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Aww, you've been buddywuddies since childhood!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Don't make up words!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He's one year older than me, but neither of us has siblings, so our parents let us play together all the time.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We used to play theater a lot when we were little.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui tried to do shows with his classmates too a few times...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But he becomes so absorbed in his shows that he loses sight of everything else, so that didn't go well.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's why he made robots for his plays, and decided to work alone.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But...I don't think that's what he really wants...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Guys, look! Isn't that Rui over there?
Looks like he's doing a show!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The lonely alchemist was deeply impressed by the performance he saw. So much so that...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He decided that he too would stage marvelous shows for everyone to enjoy!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The alchemist perfected his own show based on the play performed by the traveling troupe, and invited the townsfolk to see it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
The townsfolk greatly enjoyed it.
The alchemist finally won their acceptance and respect.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He lived happily...but not ever after.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The townsfolk told the alchemist they wanted to take part in his shows.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: At first, the alchemist was overjoyed at their request...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
However, each of his ideas was met with ridicule.
One after another, the townsfolk began to avoid him.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But we must not blame either the alchemist for his odd ideas, nor the townsfolk for their lack of understanding. They simply had a different way of thinking.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Unfortunately, in the end none of the townsfolk wanted anything to do with the alchemist, and he was left all alone once again.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene and Emu?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And I see you're here as well.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'm finished with my show.
As usual, no one stopped to hear the story.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, Rui! I need to talk to you!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
About yesterday?
There's no need. You should move on.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui... I... I decided to not give up theater.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm glad to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Rui... Be honest.
Don't you want to perform with others again?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui, I'm...really sorry about yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I was so disappointed that the show flopped that I couldn't think clearly, and I forgot what was really important.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Like you said, it takes more than one person to stage great shows! What I did was plain wrong!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm not expecting you to just forgive me, but at least, if you could come back...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So you thought about what I said?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Not to offend, but I really don't care. The argument was between you and Nene. If she forgave you, then that's good.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But we are simply not compatible.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What do you mean by that?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Your ambition to perform is motivated solely by your desire to be a popular star, correct?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I, on the other hand, want to create wonderful shows for the audience to enjoy. Our values are worlds apart.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It... It used to be like that, but now I—

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I appreciate that you gave Nene the opportunity to return to acting.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I don't feel like staging shows with you again.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
For a while, it was fun.
...Thank you for that.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh... Tsukasa!
Are you okay with just letting him walk away like this?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, of course I'm not!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But even if I went after him... What could I say to change his mind?
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What are we going to do now?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nnngh!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: H-Hey, what are you doing? You nearly stepped on my foot!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa! This isn't right! You want Rui back in our troupe, right?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: In that case, you can't just give up!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui still wants to create amazing productions, and that means he must still want to work together with others, I think...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So there must be a way to get him back!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah! And besides, you're a future star, Tsukasa!
Prove it by making Rui smile again!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You're right.
Let's put our minds together and think of what we can do!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I wonder what happened with Tsukasa and his friends.
I hope they managed to clear things up...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well, it seems we'll soon find out. Here he comes.
